scope: Six firms; nine public documents. Eight local PDFs: 229 total pages, 36 selected pages visually inspected; McKinsey: three official web exhibits visually inspected and PDF text consulted. No native Word originals verified.
method: Official-source discovery, local PDF raster review or official web screenshots, PDF text-span measurement where available. Observations describe sampled publications, not global brand standards.

sources.title: Investing in productivity growth
sources.format: Report; selected web exhibits visually inspected
observations: Exhibit 1 separates figure number, assertion headline, measure definition, plot, notes and source. Blue and grey distributions have direct year labels and median arrows.
Exhibit 5 aligns shared region rows across stacked contribution bars, change markers and a multiplier column. Group labels and section rules preserve scanning across panels.
Exhibit 8 combines a bridge, numbered explanatory brackets and a lower comparison matrix. Colour communicates signed impact, not merely decoration.

measurements.method: Official web exhibit screenshots; report PDF text checked with web reader

sources.limitations: PDF download failed locally; no PDF page geometry or native Word document verified. Web exhibit inspection must not be counted as PDF page inspection.

Page 7 aligns three comparison columns across two chart rows, followed by one takeaway region per column.

Page 18 combines a chart with an explanatory table above a new prose section, demonstrating integrated figures and narrative.

sources.title: Navigating the Vortex: 2025 Global Performance Transformation Report
sources.date_basis: 2025 edition; official article URL is under 2025/apr, but PDF creation metadata is May 8. Exact publication day not verified.
sources.format: Portrait PDF; metadata creator Adobe InDesign 19.5
observations: Page 3 uses a dark background, two-column introduction, and ruled KPI rows with a narrow metric column and wider explanation column.
Page 7 places exhibit title and survey unit above paired horizontal bars; prior-period bars are gray hatched, current-period bars black, with direct values and small change arrows.
Page 7 continues with two-column prose beneath the exhibit.
Page 18 gives a ranked horizontal bar chart most of the page and closes with a dark conclusion band.
Running heads use a thin horizontal rule; page numbers remain consistently positioned.

sources.title: Designing for 2035
sources.date_basis: PDF creation metadata and /2023/dec/ asset path; linked from a separate official February 2025 article. Do not label this PDF a 2025 publication.
sources.format: Portrait PDF; metadata creator Adobe InDesign 19.0
observations: Page 2 uses a purple condensed heading, a single prose column, generous remaining whitespace, and a running head with a fine rule.
Page 7 integrates a three-column comparison table into prose; only horizontal rules are used, and left-side labels receive purple bold emphasis.
Page 12 divides prose with compact purple section headings and bold time-context labels within paragraphs.
The hierarchy is carried by typography, spacing, and rules rather than cards or decorative icons.

measurements.method: Visual inspection of rendered PDF pages plus PyMuPDF text-span extraction; body width is approximate.
